title: NPC Shop Specialty Flags (staff)
body: Builder shorthand: MSET <mob vnum> FLAGS ShopGeneral / ShopWeapons / ShopBlacksmith / ShopFood / ShopMining / ShopFarming / ShopLumberjack / ShopGemcutter / ShopPawnshop. A specialty flag automatically enables the Shopkeeper role; choosing a new specialty replaces the old one (only one specialty per NPC). Remove with MSET <vnum> FLAGS -ShopMining; remove all shop flags with MSET <vnum> FLAGS -Shopkeeper. Existing MSET SHOPTYPE and MSET SHOPKEEPER ON/OFF still work and synchronize flags. Use MSET ADDITEM <mob vnum> <item vnum> to stock ordinary shops. Custom shop buying categories, operating hours, and pawnshop per-item persistent stock work as before.
